summary: The proposed patch introduces a method to ensure that enum values are represented as strings when used in model fields, addressing the issue reported.

issues.description: This change may introduce a behavioral regression risk by altering how enum values are stringified, which could affect other parts of the application that rely on the current behavior.
The patch introduces a new method `__str__` in the `Choices` class, which deviates slightly from the typical Django style of defining methods within models.
